title: Words — Polysemic Relay
subtitle: Discovering a word's changing senses through successive visible actions
lineage: Lineage: Everynone for WNYC Radiolab, Words (2010) · Will Hoffman & Daniel Mercadante
theorem: Make viewers discover a word's changing senses through successive visible actions, then use the discovered ambiguity to change the sequence's emotional direction. The first pass displays no organizing word.
boundary_note: No adjacent sources are presented as a documented encounter between their participants. First pass omits the organizing word ('draw') so the semantic relay is discovered visually before the annotated audit.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #03 (t=09.00s-13.50s): Internal source cut between t=10.71s and t=11.93s jumps from a hand drawing on paper to a talking-head woman speaking into a microphone.
Seg #04 (t=13.50s-19.00s): At t=14.16s-18.34s, intended 'drawing a curtain' shows an exterior architectural skyscraper spire instead of a curtain.
Seg #10 (t=43.70s-46.20s): Missing glyph boxes ('□') render between items on the Semantic Relay Audit card.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: The crucial first semantic pivot ('drawing a line' -> 'drawing a curtain') fails in Seg #03-#04: Seg #03 breaks mid-shot into a talking head, and Seg #04 shows a skyscraper spire instead of drawing a curtain.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Unverified internal source cut inside the clip window for Seg #03, OpenCLIP semantic false positive matching vertical architectural lines to 'curtain' in Seg #04, and an unsupported Unicode arrow glyph in Georgia.ttf.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Seg #03 with verified cut-free map-drawing clip `c3c494ef` (0.2s-5.2s); replace Seg #04 with verified parted stage curtain clip `016b2487` (0.5s-6.0s) and curtained window `491529e4` (0.5s-5.0s); sanitize Unicode arrows (`->`) in card/HUD renderer.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The opening compass-arc drawing in Seg #02 (`7c61b8cd`), the drawer-pulling progression (`4b91a58f`, `2541b113`), the group drawing closer (`20cf914f`), and the structural return to the original compass line.
